captions.detailed: A 3D model of a Napoleonic-era 12-pounder field cannon, consisting of a smooth-bore bronze-colored barrel, a dark brown wooden carriage trail, and two large spoked wheels. The bronze barrel is mounted on revolute trunnion joints between the cheeks of the carriage, allowing for vertical elevation. The two wooden wheels are mounted on a common axle at the sides via revolute joints, and a black metal limber tow-hook plate is attached to the rear tip of the trail.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Napoleonic 12-pounder field cannon using CadQuery. The model should feature a bronze smooth-bore barrel on a revolute trunnion joint, a wooden trail carriage, two large spoked side wheels on revolute axles, and a hinged black limber tow-hook plate at the rear.
captions.factory: The code constructs the cannon by first building the wooden carriage trail using extruded profiles and cross-beams. The barrel is modeled as a series of lofted or stepped cylinders with a hollow bore, complete with lateral trunnion cylinders. The wheels are created by patterning spokes around a central hub cylinder, enclosed by a thin outer rim. All components are positioned and articulated using revolute joints for the elevation of the barrel, the rotation of the wheels, and the pivoting of the rear tow-hook plate.
